Ah. Well, I'm an idiot.

+ show block
– hide block

So here is what happened. In the previous version of the article, I quite enjoyed the Capital R segment of the article, and since not too much appeared to change in the initial part of that section, I admit that I skimmed and missed the above details. Which is a shame, since something like this actually has precedence in Those Twisted Pines.

In Make Portland Weirder, a Way to 3Ports exists in Milo Mciver State Park (which is located in Estacada, OR). This is about 10 mins further from Portland via car than Boring, so it works out that Way could exist there.

That said, the Ways leading from Portland, Oregon to 3Ports are so numerous that they are nearly uncountable, the only issue is that most people don't know how to activate them. So it wouldn't be that hard for WWS to acquire one of them, should they so choose.

On the subject of creating Ways, while I suppose someone powerful enough (ie a reality bender) could totally create a Way to 3Ports from anywhere in the world, it would be infinitely easier to do that in one of the baseline Portlands that 3Ports overlaps (UK, Maine, or Oregon).

Anyway, I'm rambling now. Switched to an upvote.

That said, the idea of carting potentially dangerous anomalous animals into a major population center (still necessary for using ways into Three Ports) is a bit contrived, and the means of keeping this quiet still not elaborated enough to my taste. Vote changed to neutral.

But…

My favorite part about this property is that it's close to a Way, which I could, well, "hijack" makes it sound so brutish, but you get the idea. Said Way is also relatively low traffic, making this location the cheapest and fastest to transport to and from.

I guess I didn't spell it out so clearly, but that's because Ellie and I were struggling with where to fit it into the article — the idea is that Capital R is making a covert way from Boring, Oregon to Three Portlands, to avoid going through Portland, Oregon directly. Do inform me, whether this is even possible, but my headcanon says that a Way can be made from anywhere to anywhere else, with powerful enough magic.

The meeting with Capital R was successful and WWS is now in possession of the property and an associated Way.

Like, I doubt Wilson's could literally own one of the 3Ports Ways in Portland, Oregon.

item.content:encoded:
Eh. I guess I have some trouble buying the set up for this, as it has a fair number of holes in the plan, at least from my standpoint as a reader and frequent contributor to Three Portlands articles.

+ show block
– hide block

Operation: MAN's Best Friend seeks to reduce said activity through exporting it to Three Portlands via the nearby Portland, Oregon.

Right off the bat, a problem arises in that the UIU/US Government is planning on taking anomalies from a location where they are relatively commonplace and therefore easier to maintain the Veil. Even if jettisoning them into 3Ports is more stable in the end, the fact that to do so would require you to, at some point, cart anomalous animals on foot through a major civilian population center seems counterproductive to an operation whose goal is to maintain the veil. This is especially true in an era of prevalent ability for civilians being able to film and record such things.

We expect to accomplish this by supplying locals with thaumaturgically sealed vans who can then take said anomalies and sell them in the Three Portlands market through a UIU monitored Way

People always seem to forget that cars are not things that exist in Three Portlands, it even says as such on the Three Portlands info page on this wiki. This again would require you to take whatever the anomaly is out of the car and transport it through the Way on foot, which at best runs the risk of exposure without proper countermeasures, and is actively dangerous to civilians at worst.

The rest of the article, Capital R's shenanigans and the timeline are fine enough and got a chuckle out of me in a few places.

That said, the whole venture seems to be rather convoluted. Last I checked, the US Government, and the UIU, are not bound by the Foundation's Creed of protecting the anomalous even in the event of a posed threat. Given that the animals at WWS are just that, animals, if their presence in Boring was such a threat why wouldn't they just be terminated? Seems a more cost-effective solution to the problem from the US Government's end without running the risk of exposure the act of hauling them to Three Portlands would envoke.

Long post collapsed. ~Zyn

-1 from me, I'm afraid. I just don't buy this plan of attack and feel that if the goal of the US Government/UIU is to preserve the Veil here, this course of action would be a fairly poor means of doing that.

Edit: Got a chance to look this over after the recent edits made. As with GreenWolf below, I feel that the changes have made the reasoning more concrete and the plan a little more in character for the UIU of Three Portlands. That said, the idea of carting potentially dangerous anomalous animals into a major population center (still necessary for using ways into Three Ports) is a bit contrived, and the means of keeping this quiet still not elaborated enough to my taste. Vote changed to neutral.

I loved Capital R when I first gave feedback on this! Where can I read more about this mysterious and fantastical figure?

(and an easy +1, by the way)

Now, I don't know all too much about the lore behind WWS and the specifics of their character — aside from the fact that they have a rather vibrant and easily-recognizable atmosphere. However, I will say that I enjoyed what this article attempted to build up to and it seemed like a big and exciting development for the group. Enough to keep me invested all the way through.

I was never initially a fan of WWS, but now they're really growing on me — good work!

item.title: Author Post
item.content:encoded:
Reserved by the Great Reservio!! Yes, I am more enthusiastic here than in the other entry, what of it?

Woah, what a doozy! Been more than a month since I reserved this post, and now I am finally writing it. Alright! So, I decided to write this after addressing Conwell's critiques — I feel I have made this course of action more believable than perhaps it once was. Now, I am super happy to have worked with Ellie3 for this contest, and producing some more WWS content (I love writing out some sweet sweet WWS lore). This came about once we realized that there was no story on the site about how WWS had acquired an adoption center in Three Ports. Now, I know that the Adoption Poster articles have had Tim Wilson be around, but canon shmanon, this is how it be in my world.

Became close pals with Ellie through this contest, which is a bigger win than any number of upvotes, so very glad that this happened :3
